name: Kevin 1
description: The first hidden level, and the first dumplings: flour and a chopped filling mixed, then steamed, or a fish steamed as it is. A column of counters splits the room: mixers and beef on the left, steamers, flour and fish on the right.
strategy: The left chef keeps beef and flour mixing and clean plates coming; the right chef throws flour across on every trip to the crates and steams in ticket order. Fish needs no mixer, so the right side can serve it alone.
